title: Voice Mode UI
summary: A chat composer becomes a voice dock with a liquid orb, speaker colors and progressive transcripts. Play a scripted conversation to explore listening, thinking, speaking and ending states without a microphone or backend.
highlights: The voice entry button and active dock share a transition, keeping controls connected to the conversation.
A procedural orb changes palette and activity as the demo moves between self, Agent and peer speech.
Progressive transcripts, speaker status and waveform motion follow one scripted timeline.
Play, pause, replay, mute and end controls make the English/Chinese demo explorable without audio access.

zh.title: 语音模式 UI
zh.summary: 聊天输入区转为语音控制台，用流动球体、说话人配色和逐步字幕表达状态。播放示例对话，体验聆听、思考、说话和结束流程，无需麦克风或后端。
highlights: 语音入口按钮与通话控制台使用共享转场，让控件与对话保持连续。
程序化球体随本人、Agent 和同伴的示例发言切换配色与动态强度。
逐步字幕、说话人状态和波形动画共用一条示例时间线。
播放、暂停、重播、静音和结束操作让中英文演示无需音频权限即可体验。
